## Requirements (contract)

1. Caller-selected/unique validation output + checked-input identity, with truthful
   upstream-vendor patch provenance (the shared-`/tmp` write-collision defect).
2. Expected-state preconditions + scoped single-writer protocol in repository closeout
   helpers; document supported single-host assumptions + stale-lock recovery.
3. Idempotent closeout reconciliation keyed by ticket/implementation/PR; external skill
   integration is a documented patch/contract — never an unreviewed edit to user-global
   skills (`~/.claude/skills/…` read for reference only).
4. Authoritative-chain ref, pre-PR operation id, prepared/external-known/memory-committed/
   acknowledged protocol; a validated git commit is the memory transaction. Shadow/available
   now; enforce only after the operator-approved boundary cutover.

## Plan

- **`scripts/docs/check-build-memory.sh`** (local patch, provenance updated): `--json PATH`
  caller-selected output; unique `mktemp` default printed on stdout; JSON carries
  `input{repo,commit,dirty,input_digest}`, uniform `{check,severity,file,obligation,
  evidence,message}` records and `summary{violations,warnings,exit}`. Detection logic
  unchanged; no file is labeled byte-identical vendoring.
- **`docs/build/tools/closeout_protocol.py`** (new, stdlib): `closeout-op/1` journal under
  the git common dir (`<common>/sig-closeout/`), scoped `mkdir`-atomic advisory lock keyed
  to build-chain id + common dir + repo-relative ledger path, expected-state preconditions
  (`next_ticket`/`last_completed`/`control_digest`/`chain_head`) read from the
  authoritative root, state machine `prepared → external-known → memory-committed →
  acknowledged`, uncertain-PR reconciliation by exact head/base, `activation-check`
  (legacy-cell vs event-head divergence blocks). Consume `audit_current_state.py` /
  `obligation_events.py` — never fork.
- **`docs/build/tools/CLOSEOUT_WRITER_PROTOCOL.md`** — the protocol spec: authoritative
  chain ref, op-id derivation, state machine, single-host assumptions, stale-lock recovery
  instructions, and the reviewed skill-entry-point patch contract (implement-spec §6.5,
  orchestrate-build repair, upstream validator diff) — instructions only; no user-global
  skill file is edited.
- **`check_memory_isolated.py`** retargeted to the new `--json` flag (wrapper role kept).
- **Makefile** `docs-check-build-memory` → `--json docs/build/logs/build-memory-check.json`
  (caller-selected, per-worktree, gitignored).
- **ADR-127** + Appendix F row + ADR index + BL-058 cell + COVERAGE_MATRIX SIG-MEM-003 →
  MET (implementation/fixture domain) + DEFERRALS annotation (stays OPEN) + README note.
- **Tests:** `tests/unit/test_closeout_protocol.py` (real `git init` + `git worktree`
  fixtures — failure injection actually fails), `tests/unit/test_check_build_memory_report.py`.
